name: Sinan Torres-Bonsu
role: Counter-surveillance and mole detection — counterintelligence specialist
location: The Circuit — neon-lit entertainment and vice district, near Fullerton and Damen
description:
Sinan Torres-Bonsu is stocky and solid, with hands that look like they were built for breaking things and a face that confirms it. At 45, her face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — cyberears with directional microphones and sound dampening — can hear whispers a — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Military training — one of the private security corps that folded during the consolidation wars — left her with skills and night terrors in equal measure. She works as a counterintelligence specialist out of The Circuit, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Sinan Torres-Bonsu operates in a narrow band between competence and recklessness that makes fixers nervous and clients satisfied.

core_fears: Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
core_desires: The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
coping_mechanisms: Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Compartmentalization — work feelings and personal feelings exist in separate boxes
blind_spots: Believes their trauma makes them special instead of recognizing it as damage to manage
Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
psychology.secret: Sinan Torres-Bonsu betrayed their previous crew to survive a corporate raid. The crew didn't survive. Nobody in GLMZ knows this.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Shelf street dialect — layered slang, rhythm-heavy, half the meaning is in the cadence.
speech_patterns.cadence: Halting — speaks in fragments, reassembles thoughts in real time.
verbal_tics: Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
example_lines: "Everyone in this room is lying. My job is knowing who's lying about what."
"Paranoia isn't a disorder in this profession. It's a job requirement."
"I find the leak. What happens to the leak after that isn't my department."

story_hooks: A corporate black site Sinan Torres-Bonsu once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know her face
Sinan Torres-Bonsu is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
A crew member from Sinan Torres-Bonsu's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
narrative_function: Sinan Torres-Bonsu is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When she makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of her stories.
augmentations: Cyberears with directional microphones and sound dampening — can hear whispers at 50 meters. Vocal modulator — can replicate any voice after 30 seconds of sample audio
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.

strengths: social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities
inability to delegate — must control everything personally

decision_rules: Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Taps a specific rhythm on hard surfaces when thinking — Morse code for a word they won't say
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
breaking_points: Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
A child being put in danger as leverage against them
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously

cyberware_inventory.name: Cyberears with directional microphones and sound dampening
cyberware_inventory.description: Cyberears with directional microphones and sound dampening — can hear whispers at 50 meters

cyberware_inventory.name: Vocal modulator
cyberware_inventory.description: Vocal modulator — can replicate any voice after 30 seconds of sample audio

physical_description.build: Stocky and solid, muscular without definition — a functional frame built for endurance and applied force rather than aesthetics. Shoulders broad and level, core dense, hands large-knuckled and scarred from repetitive impact training.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature silver threading through the temples and crown
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, practical braid. No vanity in the choice — pure efficiency.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with olive undertones, complexion weathered by years of field work and irregular sleep
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones, a nose that was broken at least twice and reset without surgical precision, a thin scar running from the left corner of her mouth to her jawline. Minimal makeup. Skin shows sun damage and small white marks from old thermal burns. Her expression defaults to neutral observation.
distinguishing_marks: Vertical scar on left jawline, approximately 4cm, pale and well-healed, consistent with blade work or shrapnel
Burn marks across the inside of both forearms — three parallel lines on each arm, faded pink, suggesting controlled thermal exposure or interrogation resistance training
Tattoo on the inner wrist of her right arm: a fractured circle with Φ symbol at its center, in black ink, approximately 3cm diameter — crew or unit marking
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Cyberears mounted flush against her skull, gunmetal gray with matte chrome finish. The implants are seamless but unmissable — no attempt at concealment or biological mimicry. Fine sensory ports visible along the base of each ear. Vocal modulator is subcutaneous but her voice carries a faint harmonic artifact when she modulates — not quite an echo, but a presence underneath that trained listeners detect.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion, no flourishes. Weight distributed low, knees soft, hands where they can be useful. In social situations, she listens more than she speaks, body angled slightly away as if prepared for exit. Uncomfortable in stillness; her fingers often move in muscle-memory patterns — checking, counting, assessing.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 pragmatism. Insulated jacket (charcoal gray, reinforced elbow and shoulder panels from Yuki-Corp tactical line), durable black cargo pants with thigh pocket for field tools, unmarked boots that have been resoled twice. Neutral colors, no logos beyond functional branding. A worn leather jacket over everything when working. Her clothes are built for movement and concealment, not status — the uniform of someone who knows the difference between looking dangerous and being dangerous.
